messages:
sam: Quick check — onboarding gaia-7b v1 weights to dedicated pool. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/gaia/gaia-7b/v1/ (sharded). Anyone seen tokenizer mismatch with tokenizer.json vs merges?

jin: I pulled weights + vocab, tokenizer.json looks like BPE v1 but merges file is missing from that s3 prefix. runtime expects sentencepiece for some of our loaders — might be a conversion gap.

maria: On the runtime side, FYI, our servers expect kv_cache format 'packed_v2'. If we feed a v1-style per-layer kv it inflates memory (per-token allocations). I hit OOM in a quick local smoke with max_ctx=65536.

priyanka: Re: max_ctx — the upstream config.yaml defaults to 65536. That will OOM on 4xA100-80GB unless we enable compact_kv=true and reserve kv buffer growth. Recommend capping onboarding default to 32768 and adding a clear note about compact_kv and autoshrink.

noah: Also saw tokenizer edge-case: some generated token ids > vocab_size when long prefix + joiner tokens present; causes repeated <unk> and degenerate outputs around 32k+. I made a small conversion patch to clamp special ids and remap merges.

sam: Thanks. @jin can you run the convert script (tokenizer + merges + vocab normalization) and push artifacts with suffix -redwood-ready? Need a sha for reproducibility.

jin: Running the conversion now. Script used: `scripts/convert_tokenizer.sh --input s3://redwood-models/gaia/gaia-7b/v1 --out-suffix redwood-ready`. Will push to s3://redwood-models/gaia/gaia-7b/v1/redwood-ready/ with manifest.json. ETA ~15m.

maria: Also add a step to validate model config with infra tool before staging deploy:
```
python infra/tools/validate_model_config.py \
  --s3-path s3://redwood-models/gaia/gaia-7b/v1/redwood-ready/ \
  --expected-kv packed_v2 \
  --max-ctx 32768
```
CI hooks into this to block deploys if schema mismatch.

priyanka: Side note on quant: baseline q4_0 tends to increase transient kv allocation. For long contexts prefer q4_1 or q8_0 if accuracy permits. I'll add a note in onboarding PR and a perf run template.

sam: Action items: jin -> push converted tokenizer + weights and post sha; priyanka -> update onboarding PR with max_ctx cap, compact_kv recommendation, and quant hints; maria -> run validate_model_config + a 1k-token smoke on staging. I'll loop in devex for a canary template.

ops-bot: smoke run scheduled on staging cluster c-stg-3 at 1879503300. Check logs: https://staging-logs/redwood/c-stg-3/1879503300

noah: If smoke passes, I'll start canary rollout in Console and tag infra-oncall. Will add a perf trace with token breakdown.

sam: One more: we should add a quick test that runs tokenizer roundtrip for 100 random long prefixes (16k-32k) — catches the remapping bug. priyanka wanna own?

priyanka: Yep I'll add `tests/onboard/tokenizer_roundtrip_longctx.py` to the PR and wire it into the model-validation CI job.

sam: Great. Ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:

jin: pushed artifacts: s3://redwood-models/gaia/gaia-7b/v1/redwood-ready/manifest.json sha=ab12f4c9. Ran validate tool locally — two warnings about tokenizer merges ordering fixed. Starting staging smoke now.

maria: Got the artifacts, kicked off validate job in CI; will post results here when smoke completes.

noah: tagging infra-oncall and devex in case we need fast rollback plan.

sam: Perfect. Thanks all.
